description: Design and manufacture of pumps, control valves and flow instrumentation for process industries. Capital-equipment cycle exposure; the most inventory-intensive unit.
Field mechanical services, rotating equipment maintenance and plant turnarounds. Labour-intensive, low inventory, significant unbilled revenue at period end.
Custom-engineered skid packages, automation and integration delivered as long-duration projects. Revenue recognised over time; the source of contract assets and liabilities.
Spare parts, consumables and aftermarket kits distributed to the installed base. Highest gross margin, least cyclical.
Group holding, treasury, and shared finance, HR, IT and procurement functions. No external revenue; recovers cost through an intercompany management fee.
